row.body: The pickup card assigns each trailer a time, then records the vehicle at the gate before the first family is listed. The spare hitch key is still here.
row.title: The unfinished handoff

sidecar.gloss: A pickup record places transport at the gate before the household list was completed.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same route could have moved field workers or supplies; an early vehicle mark does not identify its purpose.

row.body: four notches on the garden hoe match four marks on the camera; a fifth mark was sanded flat on both.
row.title: missing count beside the garden hoe

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

row.body: You said one bite was enough, so I marked the water barrel too. The field crew calls the rinse routine; I still will not let the dog drink until the tank is flushed.
row.title: Kept from the drawer

sidecar.gloss: A family water warning follows a field crew rinse and leaves the source uncertain.
sidecar.rival_reading: A containment crew could have rinsed a trailer tank during cleanup; the warning does not establish what caused the danger.
